pwa.installDescription: Install Kikouchou on your device for quick access

manualInstall.title: Add Kikouchou to your device
manualInstall.ios: Tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen", then "Add".
manualInstall.firefoxAndroid: Open Firefox's ⋮ menu and tap "Install" — older versions call it "Add app to Home Screen".
manualInstall.firefoxWindows: Click "Add tab to taskbar" in the address bar (Firefox 142 and later). The app gets its own window, toolbar included.
manualInstall.firefoxLinux: Set browser.taskbarTabs.enabled to true in about:config, then click "Add tab to taskbar" in the address bar.
manualInstall.firefoxMac: Firefox on macOS cannot install web apps yet. Kikouchou works fully in a tab — or install it from Safari or Chrome.
manualInstall.generic: Look for "Install", "Add to Dock" or "Add to Home Screen" in your browser's menu.
